questions.q: Change into Passive Voice: 'Close the door.'
questions.explanation: Imperative command 'Verb + Object' changes to 'Let + Object + be + V3'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Change into Passive Voice: 'Who wrote this book?'
options: By whom was this book written?
By whom this book is written?
questions.explanation: 'Who' changes to 'By whom' in interrogative passive voice.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Change into Indirect Speech: The teacher said, 'The earth is round.'
options: The teacher said that the earth was round.
The teacher said earth was round.
The teacher said that the earth is round.
The teacher told that earth is round.
questions.explanation: Universal truths retain Simple Present tense even in indirect speech.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Fill in the modal verb: We _____ respect our elders.
questions.explanation: Moral duty and obligation are expressed using 'ought to' or 'should'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Fill in the modal verb: _____ God bless you!
questions.explanation: Optative sentences expressing blessings begin with 'May'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Fill in the modal verb: He is strong; he _____ lift this heavy box.
questions.explanation: Ability/capacity in the present is expressed using 'can'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct tense: By next year, I _____ my graduation.
questions.explanation: Future Perfect Tense ('shall have + V3') is used with 'by next year'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct article: She plays _____ guitar very well.
questions.explanation: Musical instruments take the article 'the' when playing is mentioned.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct article: He is _____ M.A. in English.
questions.explanation: 'M.A.' begins with an 'em' (vowel sound 'e'), so 'an' is used.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct preposition: He is senior _____ me in service.
questions.explanation: Comparative words like senior, junior, superior, inferior take 'to', not 'than'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct preposition: Divide these sweets _____ the two children.
questions.explanation: 'between' is used for two people/items.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct preposition: Distribute the apples _____ the five boys.
questions.explanation: 'among' is used for more than two people.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct preposition: He is suffering _____ fever.
questions.explanation: The verb 'suffering' takes 'from'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct preposition: She is good _____ Mathematics.
questions.explanation: The adjective 'good' takes 'at' when indicating skill.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Subject-Verb Agreement: The collector and magistrate _____ coming.
questions.explanation: When two titles refer to the same single person (indicated by single article 'The'), singular verb 'is' is used.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Subject-Verb Agreement: Fifty kilometers _____ a long distance.
questions.explanation: A specific quantity or measurement taken as a whole unit takes a singular verb.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Subject-Verb Agreement: Time and tide _____ for no man.
questions.explanation: Plural compound subject takes plural verb 'wait'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Subject-Verb Agreement: One of my friends _____ a doctor.
questions.explanation: 'One of + plural noun' takes a singular verb ('is').
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct preposition: He was accused _____ theft.
questions.explanation: The verb 'accused' takes the preposition 'of'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct preposition: Beware _____ pickpockets.
questions.explanation: The verb/adjective 'beware' takes 'of'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What is the Synonym of 'Sacred'?
questions.explanation: Sacred means holy or blessed.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What is the Synonym of 'Pardon'?
questions.explanation: Pardon means to forgive.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What is the Antonym of 'Victory'?
questions.explanation: Defeat is the opposite of victory.
questions.subject: English

Can you give me your book?
Are you giving me your book?

questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct preposition: He is interested _____ music.
questions.explanation: The adjective 'interested' takes the preposition 'in'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct preposition: She was astonished _____ his behavior.
questions.explanation: 'astonished' takes the preposition 'at'.
questions.subject: English

questions.subject: English

questions.q: Which country won the Nobel Peace Prize for Aung San Suu Kyi?
questions.explanation: The Nobel Peace Prize is awarded annually in Oslo, Norway.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Subject-Verb Agreement: Neither food nor water _____ available.
questions.explanation: Singular nouns connected by 'neither... nor' take a singular verb.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What was the name of the lawyer's prison guard in 'The Bet'?
options: He had no direct contact with any guard
questions.explanation: The lawyer lived in total isolation without seeing any human being.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Translate: 'इमानदारी सबसे अच्छी नीति है।'
questions.explanation: Standard proverb translation: 'Honesty is the best policy.'
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct preposition: He is senior _____ me.
questions.explanation: Senior takes 'to'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Subject-Verb Agreement: Neither of the two boys _____ present yesterday.
questions.explanation: 'Neither of' takes a singular verb ('was').
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct Passive Voice: 'He solved the sum.'
options: The sum is solved by him.
The sum was solved by him.
